notes:
After coding: a moment after Save and code finished, E-Sys MAX reads the modules that were coded. When one has a fault, it shows the codes and what they mean and asks whether to clear them. Only those modules, only after you press Clear them.
Service functions: new Car network card. Every module the car's gateway lists, by the bus it sits on, and which ones did not answer.
Service functions: new Battery health card. Voltage, current and temperature from the battery sensor, the engine computer's health and charge estimate, and the battery size registered in the car. It only reads.
